user.title: Add a chore
user.description: Create a new chore helper. Each chore becomes a sensor that transitions between done and overdue on the configured interval.

error.invalid_interval: Interval must be a positive number.
error.invalid_date: Date must be in YYYY-MM-DD format.

complete.name: Complete chore
complete.description: Mark a chore as completed now, returning it to "done".

snooze.name: Snooze chore
snooze.description: Snooze a chore until a given date, suppressing overdue transitions until then. Provide exactly one of snooze_days, snooze_weeks, or snooze_until.

snooze_days.name: Snooze days
snooze_days.description: Number of days to snooze from today.

snooze_weeks.name: Snooze weeks
snooze_weeks.description: Number of weeks to snooze from today.

snooze_until.name: Snooze until
snooze_until.description: Specific date to snooze until (ISO format YYYY-MM-DD).

unsnooze.name: Unsnooze chore
unsnooze.description: Cancel an active snooze, returning the chore to "done" or "overdue".
